newsitem.title: USA: Mckesson enters 5-year pact with Omnicare.
newsitem.headline: Mckesson enters 5-year pact with Omnicare.

text.p: McKesson Corp said Wednesday it will become the sole primary supplier of wholesale pharmaceuticals and related services to Omnicare Inc.
The parties said Omnicare's purchases under the five-year pact could exceed $350 million during the next 12 months and exceed $2.0 billion over the entire term.
"Our increasing market presence will allow both Omnicare and McKesson to realize substantial economies of scale in purchasing and distributing pharmaceuticals," Omnicare President Joel Gemunder said.

McKesson, based in San Francisco, California, is the nation's largest distributor of pharmaceuticals and health care products and services. It closed its purchase of Omnicare's previous supplier, FoxMeyer Drug Co, in November.
Omnicare shares were up 1/8 at 27-7/8 Wednesday.
